lunge.method: actual named heel/toe contact episodes, fixed-length forward-knee mechanics and observed one-shot timing; monocular depth remains approximate

carrying_arm_widths.method: visible initial frontal wrist/elbow widths with fixed downward arm lengths; depth remains uncalibrated

fit.foot_pitch_policy: declared flat sole, 15-degree rear toe pivot and smooth knee-angle swing; inferred source depth is not calibrated
fit.root_policy: one global source-timed support path with visible hip-relative lateral stance, eased knee-angle descent/recovery and fixed observed heel/toe anchors

head_body_clearance.method: finite convex weight-head/body surface samples; hand contact checked separately

rows.note: Every observed active heel or toe support point reaches the floor.
The observed heel and toe support patches do not sink into the floor.
Each planted support point remains on its fitted contact anchor.
The airborne foot clears the floor between observed supports.
Both legs keep their fixed fitted lengths during the step.
Both knees bend forward in the observed direction of travel.
The complete evaluated body remains above the floor.
The observed walking step advances rather than becoming an in-place repetition.
The one-way step does not invent a backwards return.
The observed starting position has extended knees.
The leading knee does not fold beyond the fitted lunge range.
The leading knee reaches the observed lowered step position.
Finite convex weight-head/body surface samples; inspect the rendered silhouette too.
